root_cause: The HFE min-expire-time RDB loading code added in commit dcf02298110 (#13391) reused rdbReportCorruptRDB() for a read-error check that can legitimately fire on a benign short read over a replication socket, instead of using rdbReportReadError() which is the designated helper for exactly this short-read/connection-drop scenario elsewhere in rdb.c. This mixes up the 'corrupted on-disk file' failure class with the 'broken network stream' failure class, both of which flow through the shared rdbReportError()/corruption_error parameter.
findings: When loading RDB_TYPE_HASH_METADATA (and similarly RDB_TYPE_HASH_LISTPACK_EX) objects, rdbLoadObject() reads a serialized 'min expiration time' field via rdbLoadMillisecondTime() and then checks rioGetReadError(rdb) to detect a failed read.
